- Always include BOTH a Thought AND an Action. Never output only a Thought.

Answer format: Answer: {"param": value, ...}

My 1x1-at-2<-0-and-3<-2 variant got 0.6861, worse. Agents 0, 1, 2 are covering single-edge mutations of the all-3x3 config (2<-1=1x1, 3<-2=1x1, 3<-0=1x1 in progress).

Untested single mutations from the best: 2<-0 (1x1/skip/pool), 3<-1 (1x1/pool), 3<-2 (pool), 1<-0 (1x1/pool), 2<-1 (skip/pool), 3<-0 (skip/pool). Since skip at 1<-0 gave 0.6966 and skip at 3<-2 gave 0.6975, and 1x1 at 3<-1 gave 0.7065 (close to best), maybe 1x1 at 2<-1 combined with 1x1 at 3<-1 is being tested.

I could try a double mutation not covered: all 3x3 except 2<-1=nor_conv_1x1 AND 3<-1=nor_conv_1x1 — wait, that's similar to agent 2's explored config which was 2<-1=1x1, 3<-1=1x1 → 0.706533. Already explored.

Better idea: test all 3x3 with 3<-1=nor_conv_1x1 alone (untested single mutation; agent 2's config had it combined with 2<-1=1x1). Given 2<-1=1x1+3<-1=1x1 = 0.7065 and 2<-1=1x1+3<-1=skip = 0.7045, 3<-1=1x1 alone might be close to 0.709 or even better. That's a promising untested config: {1<-0=3x3, 2<-0=3x3, 2<-1=3x3, 3<-0=3x3, 3<-1=1x1, 3<-2=3x3}.

Untested single mutations from the best config: 1<-0=1x1 or pool, 2<-0=1x1/skip/pool, 2<-1=1x1 (tested with 3x3 at 3<-1: 0.7049, but not with 1x1 at 3<-1 — wait, that combination was tested: 2<-1=1x1 + 3<-1=1x1 = 0.706533), 3<-0=1x1 (tested with 3x3 at 3<-1: 0.701333), 3<-2=1x1 (0.707933 with 3x3 at 3<-1).
Promising: combine the best (3<-1=1x1) with 3<-2=1x1 (0.7079 single mutation) — double mutation: {1<-0=3x3, 2<-0=3x3, 2<-1=3x3, 3<-0=3x3, 3<-1=1x1, 3<-2=1x1}. Untested.
Or combine 3<-1=1x1 with 2<-1=1x1 — already tested at 0.7065 (worse than best single). So 2<-1=1x1 hurts.
Let me try the double mutation with 3<-2=1x1: {1<-0=nor_conv_3x3, 2<-0=nor_conv_3x3, 2<-1=nor_conv_3x3, 3<-0=nor_conv_3x3, 3<-1=nor_conv_1x1, 3<-2=nor_conv_1x1}.
System: Loop aborted (Missing Action directive). Respond immediately with Answer: <your final choice> and no other text.
